overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（9 篇）、绿色金融与可持续发展（1 篇）、行为金融（1 篇）。方法上以实验方法、调查数据为主。来源分布：arXiv（7 篇）、Semantic Scholar（3 篇）、NBER（2 篇）。其中 2 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: Electricity demand has not become more price-responsive despite ninety years of technological change
papers.abstract: Energy planners have long assumed that electricity demand will grow more price-responsive as metering, automation, and storage spread, an assumption now embedded in decarbonization plans. We test it against the empirical record: 4,720 own-price elasticity estimates from 462 studies, with data spanning 1934-2024, ranked on a single ladder of identification quality from naive regressions to randomized experiments. Three findings emerge. First, the best-identified studies find smaller responses than naive ones: the publication-bias-corrected short-run elasticity is about -0.16 (a 10% rise in the electricity price cuts consumption by under 2%), and only -0.09 among the best-identified studies, whose adjusted value is statistically indistinguishable from zero. Second, responsiveness grows with time to adjust, roughly doubling from -0.16 in the short run to -0.38 in the long run as the capital stock turns over, but this pattern has itself been stable for decades. Third, and most important, responsiveness shows no upward trend across nine decades of data; if anything, the most technology-rich settings, including time-of-use pricing, are the least price-responsive in total consumption. Prices alone have not made total electricity consumption more responsive; broader demand flexibility will have to be engineered and paid for, through enabling technology, contracts, and program design.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】能源规划者长期以来一直认为，随着计量技术、自动化设施和储能系统的普及，电力需求对价格变化的响应性将会增强。这一观点现已被纳入脱碳规划之中。我们通过实证数据对此进行了验证：分析了462项研究中的4,720个电力需求价格弹性估计值，这些研究的数据覆盖了1934年至2024年的时间段，并根据研究方法的可靠性对这些估计值进行了排序（从简单的回归分析到随机实验）。研究得出了以下三个主要结论：

首先，可靠性较高的研究得出的价格弹性系数低于那些方法可靠性较低的研究：经过出版偏误校正后的短期价格弹性系数约为-0.16（即电价上涨10%时，电力消费量仅减少不到2%）；而在可靠性最高的研究中，这一系数仅为-0.09，其调整后的数值在统计上与零没有显著差异。

其次，电力需求对价格变化的响应性会随着时间的推移而增强。在短期内，这一系数为-0.16；随着资本存量的更新，长期内的响应性提升至-0.38。不过，这种变化趋势在过去几十年里基本保持稳定。

最重要的是，无论在哪个时间段内（长达九十年），电力需求对价格变化的响应性均没有上升趋势。事实上，在那些技术应用最为广泛的情境下（包括分时电价制度），总体电...。研究方法：回归分析、随机实验、实验方法。

papers.title: pAI-Econ-claude: A Gated Human-in-the-Loop Multi-Agent Architecture for AI-Assisted Economic Theory Development
papers.abstract: In many social-science research tasks, such as economics, LLM-based agents must produce outputs for which no cheap, task-complete, machine-readable correctness signal exists. This creates a distinctive reliability problem for multi-agent systems: how should generation, critique, coordination, and human judgment be organized when no component can certify the final result? We address this problem through pAI-Econ-claude, a gated, human-in-the-loop multi-agent architecture for AI-assisted economic theory development. Agents coordinate through a shared workspace of inspectable intermediate records; specialized gates diagnose targeted failure modes and recommend loopbacks without certifying correctness; and human checkpoints retain authority over decisions that are costly to reverse. We evaluate the architecture on five matched economic-theory tasks against an ungated baseline. Two evaluators blinded to configuration agreed on all five pairwise rankings, preferring the gated architecture in four tasks and the baseline in one. Mean failure severity fell from 1.58 to 1.16, while overall usefulness rose from 2.60 to 3.10. The largest observed gain occurred when a reality check rejected a false market-structure premise and a proof review prompted revision of a false welfare claim. The negative case shows that scaffolding can also compress an economically important mechanism too aggressively. The results support a bounded claim: gated oversight improves the auditability of AI-assisted economic theory without substituting for formal verification, and the allocation of irreversible human judgment is a more informative design variable than pure agent autonomy. The workflow is publicly available at https://github.com/maxwell2732/pAI-Econ-claude.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在许多社会科学研究任务中，例如经济学领域，基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体需要生成某些输出，而这些输出目前缺乏廉价、能够完全完成任务且机器可识别的正确性验证机制。这为多智能体系统带来了一个独特的可靠性问题：当没有任何一个组件能够对最终结果进行认证时，应该如何组织生成、评估、协调以及人类的判断过程？我们通过pAI-Econ-claude这一架构来解决这一问题。该架构采用了一种“门控式”（gated）且包含人类参与的多智能体设计，用于辅助经济理论的发展。各智能体通过一个共享的工作空间进行协作，该空间中存储着可检查的中间结果；专门的“门控机制”能够诊断特定的故障模式并建议必要的调整措施，但不会对结果的正确性进行认证；而人类审核人员则对那些一旦做出决策就无法轻易撤销的重要决策拥有最终决定权。我们在五个匹配的经济理论研究任务中对该架构进行了评估，并将其与未采用门控机制的基线方案进行了对比。两位对系统配置信息不知情的评估者对所有五组对比结果均达成了一致意见，在四项任务中更倾向于使用门控式架构，而在另一项任务中则更倾向于基线方案。平均故障严重程度从1.58降低到了1.16，整体实用性也从2.6...。

papers.title: The Impact of Green Finance Reform and Innovation Pilot Zone Policy on Corporate ESG Performance: A Case Study of Huayou Cobalt
papers.venue: Advances in Economics, Management and Political Sciences
papers.abstract: Whether and how the green finance innovation reform pilot zones policies (GFRPZP)affect the ESG performance of micro enterprises is an important topic in green finance research. This paper takes Huayou Cobalt, a company registered in the first batch of pilot zones, as a case, and adopts a longitudinal single-case study method to construct an analytical framework of three transmission paths: "financing constraints - information disclosure - green innovation", to investigate the mechanism by which the policies affect the ESG performance of enterprises. The research findings show that GFRPZP, through differentiated green loans and green bond issuance, effectively reduced the green financing costs of enterprises, and shifted the financing structure from mainly short-term to a balance of both short and long terms; the mandatory environmental information disclosure requirement prompted enterprises to upgrade their reporting systems from qualitative descriptions to international quantitative disclosure, forcing the improvement of ESG management capabilities; the facilitation of green finance reduced the funding threshold for green technology research and development, and enabled enterprises to make breakthroughs in clean energy, water resource recycling, and carbon emission reduction of products. These three paths form a mutually reinforcing mechanism - increased R&D investment improves environmental performance, information disclosure reduces financing costs, and abundant funds then feedback to technological innovation, ultimately driving the continuous improvement of the enterprise's ESG comprehensive performance.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】绿色金融创新改革试验区政策（GFRPZP）是否以及如何影响小微企业的ESG（环境、社会和治理）绩效，是绿色金融研究中的一个重要课题。本文以首批试点区内注册的企业华友钴业为例，采用纵向单案例研究方法，构建了“融资约束——信息披露——绿色创新”这三条传导路径的分析框架，以探讨这些政策影响企业ESG绩效的机制。研究发现，GFRPZP通过提供差异化的绿色贷款和绿色债券发行，有效降低了企业的绿色融资成本，并使企业的融资结构从以短期融资为主转变为短期和长期融资并重；强制性的环境信息披露要求促使企业将报告方式从定性描述提升为国际标准的定量披露，从而推动了企业ESG管理能力的提升；绿色金融环境的优化降低了绿色技术研发的资金门槛，使企业在清洁能源、水资源回收及产品碳排放减排等领域实现了技术突破。这三条路径形成了一个相互促进的机制：增加的研发投资提升了企业的环境绩效，信息披露降低了融资成本，而充足的资金又反哺了技术创新，最终推动了企业ESG综合绩效的持续提升。。

papers.title: Revisiting Albania's Negative Finance-Growth Nexus: A Dynamic ARDL Analysis
papers.venue: Wseas Transactions on Business and Economics
papers.abstract: This paper revisits the finance-growth nexus in Albania, providing an updated and more thorough empirical analysis of findings initially presented in previous research (2016). The original study revealed a statistically significant negative relationship between financial development and economic growth in Albania from 1994 to 2015, contradicting established beliefs. This study extends the time-series analysis to 2024 and utilizes a dynamic autoregressive distributed lag (ARDL) model to examine the persistence of the negative relationship while accounting for financial stability and institutional quality. The ARDL bounds test verifies a stable long-term cointegrating relationship among the variables. The results demonstrate that the adverse long-term correlation between financial development and economic growth has not only endured but is also substantial and highly significant. The analysis confirms that while trade openness is conducive to long-run growth, inflation has a significant negative impact. The study concludes that in Albania's post-transition context, the quality and efficiency of financial intermediation are more important than the amount of credit. These results show that we still need policies that focus on improving banking supervision to ensure that credit goes to investments that are productive and lead to long-term growth.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：该研究旨在重新审视阿尔巴尼亚金融发展与经济增长之间的负向关系，并验证其在更长时期内的持续性。

🔬 研究方法：研究将时间序列分析延长至2024年，利用动态自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型，并纳入金融稳定性和制度质量等变量进行检验。

📊 核心发现：研究证实阿尔巴尼亚金融发展与经济增长之间的负向长期相关性依然存在且高度显著；同时发现贸易开放促进长期增长，而通胀具有显著的负面影响。

💡 应用价值：研究结果表明，在阿尔巴尼亚的转型背景下，政策重点应从增加信贷规模转向提高金融中介的质量与效率，通过加强银行监管确保信贷流向生产性投资。

papers.title: Cognitive Aging and Long-Term Care in Italy
papers.abstract: This chapter examines the incidence and economic burden of cognitive impairment among older individuals in Italy within the long-term care (LTC) system. Using SHARE Wave 9 data (2022), cognitive impairment is measured through standardized memory and numeracy tests, classifying 8.6% of individuals aged 65+ as cognitively impaired. Cognitive decline rises sharply with age and is strongly associated with higher care needs, particularly intensive formal care. While both physically and cognitively impaired individuals rely heavily on informal care, cognitively impaired individuals receive substantially more hours of care. Total LTC costs amount to $35.3 billion (1.66% of GDP), with cognitively impaired individuals accounting for the largest share of expenditures. Informal care represents a greater financial burden than formal care across all groups. The findings highlight significant unmet care needs and underscore the urgent necessity of policy reforms and healthy ageing strategies to ensure LTC sustainability.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：本章旨在考察意大利长期护理（LTC）系统中老年人认知障碍的发病率及其带来的经济负担。

🔬 研究方法：研究利用2022年SHARE Wave 9数据，通过标准化的记忆和算术测试来衡量认知障碍。

📊 核心发现：认知衰退随年龄急剧上升且与更高的护理需求密切相关；认知障碍个体占总LTC支出的最大份额，且非正式护理的财务负担大于正式护理。

💡 应用价值：研究揭示了巨大的未满足护理需求，强调了迫切需要政策改革和健康老龄化战略以确保长期护理的可持续性。

papers.title: Severe Cognitive Impairments and Long-term Care in Germany
papers.abstract: Germany experiences an increase in LTC recipients, due to population ageing but also to reforms which made LTC benefits easier accessible for individuals with cognitive impairments. Previous studies documented the cost of long-term care, and how it evolved. However, less is known about the specific case of elderly people suffering from cognitive impairment. Thus, we measure the economic costs of cognitive impairment, which include extensive medical, nursing care and at-home long-term care. We use the SHARE, the Survey on Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe, Wave 9. We observe 4% of elderly people living at home with severe cognitive impairment (SCI) (Langa et al. (2017) definition). These individuals are 30% more likely to receive any care, and obtain on average 6 more hours of formal care and 6 more hours of informal care per week. The main driver is not the cognitive impairment per-se but the limitation in activities of daily living (ADLs) which SCI leads to. Thus, once controlling for ADLs, SCI does not explain any additional probability to use care. However, because people with SCI are more likely to have ADLs, the annual cost of their care is estimated to 10,000 euros per year per individual on average.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】德国长期护理（LTC）服务接受者的数量有所增加，这既归因于人口老龄化，也得益于相关改革措施——这些改革使得认知障碍患者更容易获得长期护理福利。以往的研究已经记录了长期护理的成本及其变化趋势，但对于患有认知障碍的老年人群体的具体情况了解较少。因此，我们研究了认知障碍带来的经济成本，这些成本包括大量的医疗护理、专业护理以及居家长期护理费用。我们使用了欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查（SHARE）的第九波数据。研究发现，4%的老年人在家中生活且存在严重的认知障碍（根据Langa等人的定义）。这类人群接受护理的可能性高出30%，平均每周接受6小时的专业护理和6小时的非专业护理。导致这一现象的主要因素并非认知障碍本身，而是认知障碍所引发的日常生活活动（ADLs）受限。在控制了日常生活活动受限因素后，认知障碍本身并未显著增加人们接受护理的概率。然而，由于认知障碍患者更可能出现日常生活活动受限的情况，因此他们每年的护理费用平均约为每人10,000欧元。。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: Portfolio Optimization under Dynamic Rebalancing via Topological Data Analysis and News Sentiments
papers.abstract: Understanding similarity among financial assets is essential for effective portfolio diversification. This paper proposes a novel sentiment-adjusted portfolio optimization framework that integrates Topological Data Analysis (TDA) with technical indicators and FinBERT-based sentiment scores extracted from financial news. A TDA-based distance measure is employed within an agglomerative clustering framework to identify topologically dissimilar assets for portfolio construction. By incorporating sentiment information, the framework captures rapid changes in market perception and investor behavior that are not reflected by technical indicators alone. Unlike conventional correlation and Euclidean distance based approaches, the proposed method characterizes complex nonlinear relationships through topological summaries. To account for the transient nature of market sentiment, a dynamic rolling-window rebalancing strategy with frequent portfolio updates is adopted. A retention mechanism is further introduced to preserve high-quality assets across consecutive rebalancing windows, thereby reducing portfolio turnover and transaction costs. Extensive empirical analysis on S&P 500 constituents demonstrates that the proposed framework consistently outperforms correlation and Euclidean distance based methods, as well as benchmark strategies including Naïve, Index, and full-universe portfolios, in terms of returns and reward-risk performance. Furthermore, the framework exhibits strong robustness by delivering positive performance during periods of heightened market uncertainty, such as the U.S.-Israel-Iran conflict.
papers.summary_zh: 【行为金融】理解金融资产之间的相似性对于实现有效的投资组合多样化至关重要。本文提出了一种新颖的情感调整投资组合优化框架，该框架将拓扑数据分析（TDA）与技术指标以及从财经新闻中提取的基于FinBERT的情感评分相结合。在聚类分析框架内，采用基于TDA的距离度量方法来识别在拓扑结构上存在差异的金融资产，从而用于构建投资组合。通过融入情感信息，该框架能够捕捉到仅靠技术指标无法反映的市场认知和投资者行为的快速变化。与传统基于相关性和欧几里得距离的方法不同，所提出的方法通过拓扑摘要来表征复杂的非线性关系。为了解释市场情绪的瞬变性，采用了动态滚动窗口再平衡策略，并频繁更新投资组合。此外，还引入了一种保留机制，以确保在连续的再平衡窗口中保留高质量资产，从而降低投资组合的换手率和交易成本。通过对标准普尔500指数成分股的广泛实证分析表明，该框架在回报和风险收益表现方面，始终优于基于相关性和欧几里得距离的方法，以及包括简单投资组合、指数投资组合和全市场投资组合在内的基准策略。此外，在市场不确定性加剧的时期（如美以伊冲突期间），该框架仍表现出较强的稳健性，能够保持良好的投资表现。。研究方法：优化方法。

papers.title: Accelerating fossil gas independence in Europe
papers.abstract: Recent price shocks have prompted calls to curb Europe's dependence on fossil gas imports, but the cost of this goal, and the consumer protection it affords, remain uncertain. Here we address this gap by imposing constraints on fossil gas supply in a European energy system model that co-optimises abatement across all gas uses at high spatio-temporal resolution. Cutting import reliance proves economically compelling: through savings in power generation and low-temperature heat in industry and buildings, Europe can halve its natural gas consumption for 16bnEUR/a, aligning demand with the continent's production capacity of 200 bcm. This extra system cost is comparable to what consumers spend today on a 2 EUR/MWh rise in gas import prices. However, this sovereignty alone does not shield consumers from global gas price volatility: we find that, even at a small share of the mix, gas remains dominant in shaping the marginal electricity price, leaving consumers exposed without additional policy measures.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】近期价格波动引发了减少欧洲对化石天然气进口依赖的呼声，但实现这一目标的成本以及由此带来的消费者保护效果仍存在不确定性。为解决这一问题，我们在一个欧洲能源系统模型中对化石天然气供应进行了限制，该模型能够在高时空分辨率下同时优化所有天然气用途的减排效果。减少对进口的依赖在经济上具有可行性：通过节省发电成本以及工业和建筑领域的低温供热费用，欧洲每年可减少160亿欧元的天然气消耗量，从而使天然气需求与大陆2000亿立方米的生产能力相匹配。这一额外的系统成本与消费者因天然气进口价格上涨2欧元/兆瓦时所承担的费用相当。然而，仅依靠这种自主性并不能使消费者免受全球天然气价格波动的影响：我们的研究发现，即使在天然气消费结构中占比很小，天然气仍会在很大程度上决定电力价格的走势，因此若不采取额外政策措施，消费者仍将面临价格风险。。

papers.title: Trust by Context, Not by Design? A Quantitative Study of Data Donation Willingness for Open-Source Civic AI in Switzerland
papers.abstract: Civic AI systems increasingly support democratic participation, yet interactions with them may reveal sensitive political views, creating tension between improving AI models and residents' expectations of privacy and consent. This study examines the conditions of transparency and user control under which Swiss residents are willing to donate their anonymized chatbot conversations to train an open-source AI model. A 2x2 between-subjects factorial design evaluated how a Data Nutrition Label and a granular consent dashboard influence donation decisions. The experiment was delivered via a multilingual online survey featuring a custom chatbot powered by the Apertus-70B model. Analysis of the 205 participants revealed that neither transparency nor control significantly affected donation behavior. Rates were uniformly high (91.7% overall), producing a ceiling effect, and Bayesian checks confirmed the absence of treatment effects. The dashboard raised perceived control but not donation, and high-control participants actively restricted their data-use settings. A qualitative analysis of 120 open-ended responses indicates that residents framed donation as a contribution to the public good, motivated by democratic participation, an open-source model, and research, while many regarded their anonymized queries as non-personal and therefore low in risk. Interpreted through the privacy calculus, a high perceived benefit coincided with a low perceived risk under high institutional trust, so both sides of the trade-off aligned and interface design had little leverage. Offering control served less to raise donation than to let residents define the terms of their contribution.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】公民人工智能系统日益支持民主参与，但与之互动的过程中可能会暴露用户的敏感政治观点，这在提升人工智能模型的性能与居民对隐私和同意权的期望之间引发了矛盾。本研究探讨了在何种透明度和用户控制条件下，瑞士居民愿意捐赠其匿名化的聊天记录以用于开源人工智能模型的训练。实验采用了2×2的被试间因子设计，分析了数据使用说明（Data Nutrition Label）和详细隐私控制面板（granular consent dashboard）对捐赠决策的影响。实验通过多语言在线调查进行，其中使用了基于Apertus-70B模型的定制聊天机器人。对205名参与者的数据分析表明，透明度和控制程度均未能显著影响他们的捐赠行为。总体捐赠率高达91.7%，呈现出“天花板效应”（即捐赠率无法进一步提高）；贝叶斯检验也确认了这两种因素并未对捐赠决策产生实际影响。隐私控制面板虽然提升了用户的控制感，但并未增加捐赠意愿；那些选择高度控制权限的参与者还主动限制了数据的使用方式。对120条开放式回答的定性分析显示，居民将捐赠行为视为对公共利益的贡献，其动机包括对民主参与的认同、对开源技术的支持以及对研究的促进作用；同时，...。研究方法：贝叶斯方法、实验方法、调查数据。

papers.title: Execution and Evaluation: A New Occupational Measure and Long-Run Employment Gradients
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence automates execution more readily than evaluation: producing output is cheap, judging whether it is correct is not. Exposure measures rank tasks by whether AI can perform them, not by which function the human supplies. I score all $19{,}265$ O*NET task statements under fixed rubrics to build occupation-level execution and AI-capability shares. The execution share is reproducible across model coders and O*NET vintages and distinct from AI capability and routine-task intensity; it is a model-based measure, not human-validated ground truth, and adds only modest power beyond O*NET's evaluation activities. In a harmonized panel, employment growth is lower in execution-heavy white-collar occupations in every window since 2012, and equality of slopes cannot be rejected: the gradient is a secular trend rather than an AI-era event, largely between occupational families. The vintage-valid capability gradient steepens after 2022, a change that is dated but not causally attributable. The evidence establishes a measure and a chronology, not an AI-caused effect.
papers.summary_zh: 【劳动经济学】人工智能在执行任务方面比进行评估更为高效：生成输出的成本较低，而判断其正确性的成本则较高。评估指标是根据人工智能是否能够完成任务来对各项任务进行排序的，而非根据人类所执行的具体功能来进行排序。我使用统一的评分标准对所有19,265项O*NET任务陈述进行了评分，以确定各职业在执行任务方面的能力以及人工智能在这些任务中的辅助作用。这种执行能力在不同模型编码器及不同版本的O*NET系统中具有可重复性，且与人工智能本身的能力及常规任务的复杂程度无关；该指标是基于模型的评估结果，并非经过人类验证的“真实数据”，其补充作用相对有限，仅在一定程度上增强了O*NET原有的评估功能。自2012年以来，在每个时间窗口内，以执行任务为主的白领职业的就业增长速度均较低；此外，不同职业之间的就业增长趋势并无显著差异（即增长斜率相似），这一现象并非由人工智能时代所导致，而是长期存在的职业结构特征。2022年后，各职业的能力梯度有所加剧，但这种变化并非由人工智能直接引起的。现有证据建立了一种评估方法及时间序列框架，但并未证实人工智能是导致这些变化的原因。。

papers.title: The Human-AI Substitution Principle: When will you be replaced by AI in your organization?
papers.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming organizations, raising a fundamental organizational and economic question: when will a human employee be replaced by AI? We present an analytical model for studying Human--AI Task Allocation (HAT) in hierarchical organizations. A central feature of the HAT model is that it formally encodes the economic asymmetry between human skill acquisition and AI capability scaling. The HAT model allows us to derive how risk-adjusted costs, skills, organizational depth, deployment scale, strategic adaptation, and risk jointly determine when, where, why, and under what structural conditions human--AI replacement occurs. A key result is the Human--AI Substitution Principle, which provides a precise condition --- grounded in the formal asymmetry assumption --- under which AI replaces human labor. Building on this result, we show that AI adoption can produce abrupt workforce transitions, hybrid human--AI organizations, including cases where risk heterogeneity sustains human and AI roles without requiring a minimum-human-fraction constraint, and flatter managerial hierarchies with wider spans of control. The HAT model identifies structural conditions under which middle-management roles exhibit elevated vulnerability to automation, and shows that the vulnerability of highly skilled workers depends on a skill threshold shaped by organizational depth, baseline costs, and risk differentials. More broadly, the paper connects automation economics, organizational design, AI governance, and workforce planning into a unified theory of AI-driven organizational transformation.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】人工智能（AI）正在迅速改变各种组织结构，由此引发了一个根本性的组织和经济问题：人类员工何时会被AI取代？我们提出了一个分析模型，用于研究层级化组织中的人机任务分配（Human–AI Task Allocation，简称HAT）现象。该模型的核心特点在于它正式量化了人类技能获取与AI能力提升之间的经济不对称性。通过这个模型，我们可以探讨风险调整后的成本、员工技能、组织层级结构、应用规模、战略适应能力以及风险因素如何共同决定人类与AI之间的替代关系发生的时间、地点、原因以及具体的组织条件。其中一个关键结论是“人机替代原则”（Human–AI Substitution Principle），该原则基于上述的经济不对称性假设，明确指出了AI取代人类劳动力的具体条件。在此基础上，我们进一步指出AI的采用可能导致劳动力结构的突然转变，形成人机协同工作的混合组织形态；在某些情况下，即使没有最低人力比例的限制，风险差异仍能维持人类与AI各自的角色分工；同时，AI的应用还会导致管理层级结构趋于扁平化，管理者的管理范围扩大。该模型还揭示了中层管理职位在自动化进程中更容易受到冲击的结构性因素，并说明...。

papers.title: Premium Pricing Economics and SWOT Analysis of Cultural Markets
papers.venue: Journal of Mathematical Finance and Risk Management
papers.abstract: The study aims at examining the concept of premium pricing and characteristics of supply and demand as well as behavior of the consumers of culture-based products in economics and business perspectives. Through the study of the different types of violins and concert tickets, it identifies the premium pricing rate in the market by comparison through SWOT analysis. It is found that rareness of supply and price inelasticity are the two key factors affecting the premium of culture-based goods while identity of the consumer, aesthetic preference and marketing strategies are instrumental in determining the premium pricing.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究旨在从经济学和商业的角度探讨溢价定价的概念、供需特征以及文化产品的消费者行为。通过分析不同类型的小提琴和音乐会门票，运用SWOT分析法对市场中的溢价定价水平进行了对比研究。研究发现，供应的稀缺性和价格弹性不足是影响文化产品溢价水平的两个关键因素，而消费者的身份认同、审美偏好以及营销策略在决定溢价定价方面也起着重要作用。。
